children.name: Palythoa heliodiscus
children.description: Palythoa heliodiscus, the sunray zoanthid, is a species of cnidarian in the family Sphenopidae.

children.name: Palythoa mutuki
children.description: Palythoa mutuki is a species of zoanthid generally found in the Indo-Pacific but also common off the west coast of South America.

children.name: Palythoa toxica Walsh & Bowers, 1971
children.description: Palythoa toxica, also referred to by its Hawaiian common name, limu-make-o-Hana ('seaweed of death from Hana'), is a species of zoanthid native to Hawaii.

children.name: Palythoa tuberculosa
children.description: Palythoa tuberculosa, also known as the pillow zoanthid, or rubbery zoanthid, is a species of cnidarian in the family Sphenopidae.
